messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable “Bishojo game” in the existing project.

## Requirements
- Deliver a playable game without asking clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- If checking screenshots, save small JPEGs (viewport ≤1280px wide) and inspect only the latest one.

## Decisions
- Built a cozy visual novel, “Petals After Class,” with two romance routes, choice-driven dialogue, and alternate endings.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added a self-contained game in `index.html` with responsive styling, original SVG character art, branching story routes, keyboard/touch-friendly controls, restart, and optional ambient tone.
- Verified embedded JavaScript syntax with Node (`JavaScript syntax OK`).

### Active
- Browser-playtest the game, including both routes and endings, and check responsive layout.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Run the game in a browser and test start, dialogue progression, both route choices, and endings.
2. Fix any issues discovered; take and inspect a current small JPEG screenshot if useful.
3. Summarize the delivered game and assumptions to the user.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Entire game implementation.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; project currently contains untracked files, including `index.html`.
- No browser screenshot or interaction test has been performed yet.

Usage: playwright-cli <command> [args] [options]

  open [url]                  open the browser

Navigation:
  go-back                     go back to the previous page
  go-forward                  go forward to the next page

Keyboard:

  keydown <key>               press a key down on the keyboard
  keyup <key>                 press a key up on the keyboard

Mouse:

Storage:

  state-save [filename]       saves the current storage (authentication) state to a file
  cookie-list                 list all cookies (optionally filtered by domain/path)
